behaviors.precondition: An editable scene has either a selected target node, a scene root, or an existing usable PVController; the game is not running.
behaviors.public_action: Invoke the registered Flow F4 action or the equivalent Enter Flow button.
behaviors.expected_result: Flujo reuses one compatible controller or creates exactly one undoable scene-owned PVController, selects it, and enters FLOW; Undo and Redo preserve the scene history.
invariants: No duplicate controller is created by repeated requests.
GAME never consumes F4 for editor interaction.
A second F4 leaves FLOW without deleting the controller.

behaviors.precondition: The Fluo Flow panel has less vertical space than the complete selected-item editor requires.
behaviors.public_action: Scroll the Fluo Flow panel with its native vertical ScrollContainer.
behaviors.expected_result: The vertical range exceeds the visible page and the final configuration controls can be brought fully into view.
invariants: One vertical scroll surface contains the complete configuration area.
Horizontal resizing remains native and unconstrained.
Selection and model state are not changed by scrolling.

behaviors.precondition: A schema 3 collection row or one of its public editor controls is active.
behaviors.public_action: Use public selection, Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Escape, F2, popup, Move, Undo, or Redo interactions.
behaviors.expected_result: The selected stable ID and current Flow/Fluo context remain aligned while focus follows only deliberate user navigation.
invariants: Selection identity never depends on the visible name or row index.
Rebuilds do not retain callbacks to detached controls.
Automatic model changes do not steal focus from unrelated editor controls.

behaviors.precondition: A Flow collection row remains semantically selected while keyboard focus belongs to another editor control.
behaviors.public_action: Move focus away from the selected ItemList without changing selection.
behaviors.expected_result: The stable-ID selection remains semantically active; a stronger cross-theme visual shade is explicitly deferred.
invariants: No focus is stolen to manufacture a visual indication.
Operations continue to target the selected stable ID.

behaviors.area: Delete, Undo, Redo, selection, and focus
behaviors.precondition: A deletable Method, Variable, Process, Timer, or supported block is selected through the real Inspector/plugin/Fluo path.
behaviors.public_action: Confirm Delete, then invoke scene-context Undo and Redo.
behaviors.expected_result: Delete chooses the same-index successor or prior final row, Undo selects the restored item, Redo restores the replacement, and an empty collection clears the editor.
invariants: The model and visible selected row refer to the same stable ID.
Focus is preserved only when the operation originated in that interface.
The command remains in the owning PVController scene history.
behaviors.notes: The focal verifies stable-ID row and Flow/Fluo recovery across Inspector-property replacement for Delete, Undo, and Redo, including active-block Flusso closure, focus ownership and teardown.

behaviors.precondition: A schema 2 FlowGraph satisfies its source validator and any legacy constructor payload receives the required explicit confirmation in chained steps.
behaviors.public_action: Call FlowGraphMigrator.migrate_schema_2_to_5().
behaviors.expected_result: The public 2→3→4→5 chain returns an independent validated schema 5 candidate and never mutates its source.
invariants: Every schema boundary remains explicit.
IDs, order, null positions, Variables, and invalid literal references are preserved according to their contracts.
A rejected step publishes no partial candidate.

behaviors.precondition: A runtime PVController enters a SceneTree with a valid schema 5 class definition or prepared inherited layout.
behaviors.public_action: Read, write, or reset an enabled INSTANCE attribute by stable ID and requester class ID.
behaviors.expected_result: Each controller owns an independent deeply detached value initialized from its definition default.
invariants: Definitions are never mutated.
Exact type, nullability, visibility, READONLY, and CONST rules are deterministic.
No Node, Resource, Callable, or static process-global store is retained.

behaviors.precondition: Controllers in one SceneTree resolve the same schema 5 declaring class.
behaviors.public_action: Acquire the class store and read, write, or reset a CLASS attribute by stable ID.
behaviors.expected_result: Controllers share one value only within SceneTree plus declaring class ID, retain it across scene changes, and lose it when that SceneTree ends.
invariants: Different SceneTrees and class IDs never share state.
A derived handle routes inherited CLASS slots to the declaring-class store.
Conflicting metadata rejects without resetting existing values.

behaviors.area: Schema 5 inherited attribute layout and access
behaviors.precondition: The active schema 5 graph and its saved ancestors resolve through a valid portable FlowClassCatalog.
behaviors.public_action: Resolve FlowRuntimeAttributeLayout and access slots with requester_class_id.
behaviors.expected_result: The effective layout is base→derived, each slot retains declaring_class_id, and access follows PUBLIC, PROTECTED, and PRIVATE rules.
invariants: A repeated stable ID anywhere in the hierarchy is an error.
A PRIVATE name on either side is an independent slot; PUBLIC/PROTECTED homonyms remain rejected.
Missing bases, cycles, excessive depth, and locator conflicts reject deterministically without mutation.

behaviors.precondition: An enabled PVController with a validated schema 3 graph enters the SceneTree.
behaviors.public_action: Allow PVController startup to invoke the Ready executor.
behaviors.expected_result: Enabled Ready processes execute their supported blocks once and emit console plus structured output in authored order.
invariants: Unsupported or invalid blocks are diagnosed and later blocks continue.
Definitions remain immutable.
Schema 5 never enters the schema 3 executor.

behaviors.precondition: A validated schema 3 container is executed with blocks using the default continuation or an ephemeral navigation decision.
behaviors.public_action: Execute the container through FlowReadyExecutor.
behaviors.expected_result: CONTINUE preserves linear order; JUMP resolves a stable target ID in the same container; STOP ends that path; invalid targets and accidental loops stop deterministically.
invariants: Existing output and method blocks retain default CONTINUE behavior.
The executor resolves navigation generically without knowing a concrete control-block type.
Navigation decisions and context are runtime-only and do not change schema or persistence.

behaviors.precondition: A valid schema 3 output-block container is authored through the normal Flujo Add controls.
behaviors.public_action: Add Custom Hello, persist and reload the graph or scene, then start the owning PVController.
behaviors.expected_result: The same registered concrete block survives persistence and emits Hola desde un bloque personalizado through the normal structured runtime output.
invariants: Print and Everything Flows continue through the same FlowOutputBlock execution contract.
The editor and executor contain no Custom-specific branch or dedicated control.
Stable block IDs, concrete script type, order, null positions, and schema 3 compatibility are preserved.

behaviors.precondition: An enabled schema 3 Timer has a finite positive interval and its PVController is enabled in the SceneTree.
behaviors.public_action: Start controller runtime and emit the internal Timer timeout.
behaviors.expected_result: One-shot or repeating Timers execute supported blocks in order and clean up their internal Timer nodes at shutdown.
invariants: Invalid or disabled Timers never start.
Runtime Timer nodes are not persisted into the authored scene.
Ready and Timer share the structured output boundary.

behaviors.precondition: A schema 3 PVController starts with enabled legacy Constructor blocks.
behaviors.public_action: Run the guarded controller startup sequence.
behaviors.expected_result: Constructor blocks execute exactly once immediately before Ready.
invariants: This is not Godot native _init.
Method calls inside Constructor remain unsupported and are skipped diagnostically.
Schema 4 and schema 5 declarative Constructor data is never executed through this path.

behaviors.precondition: A Ready or Timer Call Method block references an enabled starter Method by stable ID.
behaviors.public_action: Execute the containing Ready or Timer blocks.
behaviors.expected_result: The referenced Method executes its supported blocks once and returns control to the caller's next block.
invariants: Renaming does not alter the stable reference.
Missing, invalid, disabled, nested, or signature-bearing targets are diagnosed and skipped.
Arguments, returns, recursion, and method-to-method calls remain deferred.

behaviors.precondition: A v1 package manifest and its block descriptors are represented in memory without package discovery.
behaviors.public_action: Construct and validate FlowPackageManifest and FlowExternalBlockDescriptor values.
behaviors.expected_result: Valid required fields preserve order and derive package_id:type_id; empty, mismatched, duplicate, null, and unsupported-version data is rejected deterministically.
invariants: The descriptor layer does not parse JSON, discover packages, load scripts, instantiate blocks, or modify FlowBlockRegistry.
No IF-specific type, editor control, schema change, or runtime executor dependency is introduced.
The approved manifest fields are the only represented package contract in this foundation.

behaviors.precondition: A project-owned flow_packages fixture contains package directories and v1 manifest JSON files, including invalid siblings.
behaviors.public_action: Run FlowPackageManifestLoader.discover() against the project package root.
behaviors.expected_result: Packages are processed by sorted package_id, valid manifests and ordered descriptors are returned, and invalid packages produce deterministic diagnostics without preventing valid siblings.
invariants: Only manifest metadata is parsed; script existence, inheritance, loading and instantiation are deferred.
Relative script paths cannot escape their package through parent traversal.
The loader does not modify FlowBlockRegistry, editor state, runtime execution, schemas or package files.

behaviors.precondition: A metadata-valid package manifest references scripts inside its package, including valid and invalid resources.
behaviors.public_action: Run FlowExternalBlockScriptValidator.validate() for the discovered manifest.
behaviors.expected_result: Existing, loadable scripts deriving from FlowBlock are accepted; missing, non-Script, invalid, and non-FlowBlock resources receive deterministic diagnostics while later descriptors continue.
invariants: Validation uses script metadata and the existing get_base_script chain without retaining or registering instances.
No external type name, IF block, registry entry, editor control, runtime execution, or schema change is introduced.
Accepted descriptors remain in manifest order and diagnostics retain stable paths and package:type IDs.

behaviors.precondition: Integrated Registry entries and metadata/script-validated external manifests are available as ephemeral discovery results.
behaviors.public_action: Combine FlowBlockRegistry entries with valid external descriptors for authoring queries.
behaviors.expected_result: Integrated Print, Everything Flows, and Custom Hello entries remain first; valid external entries follow by package and manifest order with package:type_id keys.
invariants: Invalid metadata packages and invalid external scripts are excluded without preventing valid packages.
FlowBlockRegistry remains an integrated-block factory and contains no external package references.
The catalog does not modify popup/editor controls, instantiate blocks, execute runtime code, change schema, or know IF.

behaviors.precondition: A catalog entry comes from a metadata- and script-validated external descriptor inside a project-owned package.
behaviors.public_action: Ask FlowExternalBlockFactory to create one block from the external catalog entry.
behaviors.expected_result: The factory resolves and revalidates the declared script, calls Script.new(), returns a FlowBlock with a fresh stable ID and the descriptor display name, and rejects stale or non-external entries deterministically.
invariants: Each creation returns an independent instance and ID; no instance is retained, registered, executed, or serialized by the factory.
FlowBlockRegistry, FlowReadyExecutor, schema persistence, editor controls, and IF remain unaware of external creation.
A missing, invalid, unavailable, non-instantiable, or non-FlowBlock script produces diagnostics without affecting other catalog entries.

behaviors.area: Generic external block validation and duplication hooks
behaviors.precondition: A FlowGraph contains a FlowBlock subclass with optional structure checks or ID-addressed internal references.
behaviors.public_action: Validate the graph or duplicate it through the existing FlowGraph model API.
behaviors.expected_result: FlowBlock receives a validation context during graph validation and the complete old-ID → new-ID map during duplication; the base hooks remain no-op.
invariants: Existing built-in blocks retain their validation, persistence, and duplication behavior.
External hooks do not add schema fields, package registration, executor knowledge, or FlowIfBlock-specific behavior.
Stable IDs, ordering, null positions, and the source graph remain protected during duplication.

behaviors.precondition: A schema 3 supported container row is visible in the Godot Inspector and Fluo is configured for the same PVController.
behaviors.public_action: Activate the existing container row by double-click or Enter.
behaviors.expected_result: Fluo opens for that stable container ID with Flow visible, Flusso closed, and Flow focused on its first block or first Add-block button when empty.
invariants: The Inspector never creates a duplicate Blocks list.
The drawer reuses the live FlowGraph model instead of duplicating state.
Internal VP/PV class names are not renamed by the presentation change.
behaviors.notes: Manual desktop review is recorded separately. Final focal Process/Timer editor run on 2026-10-28 passed.

behaviors.area: Flusso live configuration and session revert
behaviors.precondition: A Flow block is selected and Flusso is open for that stable block ID.
behaviors.public_action: Modify supported configuration fields, press Revertir, or close Flusso with Escape/X.
behaviors.expected_result: Supported edits update the model immediately; Escape/X only closes; Revertir restores the persistent snapshot captured when the current Flusso session opened, but only for properties owned by rendered Flusso controls, and keeps the panel open.
invariants: Closing Flusso does not decide whether an edit persists.
Revertir applies to configuration, not destructive structural deletion.
Closing Flusso restores keyboard focus to the same selected Flow block after any rebuild.
A property existing on FlowBlock is not automatically owned by Flusso; unknown external exported properties remain untouched.
behaviors.notes: D3 extends the existing Flusso/Revertir boundary with owned-property snapshots. Explicit owned properties are display_name, enabled, text, and method_id; D4-A/D4-B provide generic reflection and D4-C provides the generic renderer. Final focal Process/Timer and owned-property runs on 2026-10-28 passed.

behaviors.precondition: Fluo is open and keyboard focus is inside the drawer.
behaviors.public_action: Use Up/Down, PageUp/PageDown, Ctrl+PageUp/PageDown, Alt+PageUp/PageDown, or Alt+Shift+PageUp/PageDown.
behaviors.expected_result: Up/Down follows the Flow list; Ctrl+Page keys cycle Flow blocks; plain Page keys cycle the current Inspector container view and synchronize its visible selection without moving keyboard focus out of Flow; Alt+Page keys cycle Flusso controls with Shift reversing direction.
invariants: Flow block navigation is circular by stable ID.
Inspector-level Page navigation closes stale Flusso options for the old container.
Repeated navigation remains usable after UI rebuilds because focus returns to Flow.
behaviors.notes: Final focal Process/Timer editor run on 2026-10-28 passed.

behaviors.area: Fluo drawer shell, close hierarchy and side placement
behaviors.precondition: The editor plugin has mounted one FluoDrawer on the Godot editor base.
behaviors.public_action: Open Fluo, toggle its side switch, close Flusso, close Fluo, or click outside the drawer.
behaviors.expected_result: One overlay drawer is reused, side placement changes immediately, first Escape closes Flusso when present, subsequent Escape/top X/exterior click closes Fluo, and valid prior focus can be restored.
invariants: The production plugin does not mount or resize the legacy dock.
Backdrop input is consumed rather than leaked to editor controls underneath.
Touch-oriented close buttons keep their intended minimum target size.

behaviors.area: Fluo primary surface and legacy dock compatibility boundary
behaviors.precondition: The plugin loads in the Godot editor with the Inspector relay and Fluo composition available.
behaviors.public_action: Inspect the mounted editor composition and open Fluo through its menu, F4, Inspector, or Flow path.
behaviors.expected_result: The plugin mounts one Fluo overlay, keeps Flow and Flusso usable, and does not mount/register the legacy VPFlujoDock or Open Fluo (POC) surface.
invariants: The legacy vp_flujo_dock.gd implementation remains available only for isolated compatibility coverage.
Removing the visible dock does not remove shared model, runtime, command, Inspector, F4, or Fluo behavior.
The Inspector remains the container entry point and does not gain a duplicate Blocks list.
behaviors.notes: Guardería editor cleanup evidence: legacy production mounting/registration is absent while the Fluo-primary Add and configuration path remains available.

behaviors.precondition: A Godot 4.7 Control fixture exercises the offset-transform properties used by the Fluo MotionShell boundary.
behaviors.public_action: Run the focused offset-transform characterization fixture with disabled/enabled position offsets, both visual-only modes, focus, mouse filtering, Container layout, and ScrollContainer layout.
behaviors.expected_result: Disabled transforms do not apply the offset; enabled transforms apply position; visual_only=true preserves the logical input region; visual_only=false moves input with the presentation; focus remains assigned; IGNORE → STOP dispatch works; Container layout stays logical; and ScrollContainer keeps its logical layout and native range.
invariants: The characterization does not infer touch or Android behavior from desktop input evidence.
Presentation offset does not rewrite Container-managed child geometry.
The interactive Fluo shell uses visual_only=false and verifies transformed hit reception separately from transform geometry.
behaviors.notes: Automatic marker: [Flujo] Fluo offset transform characterization test passed. Touch/Android behavior is not claimed by this automatic evidence.

behaviors.precondition: The editor-side Fluo host mounts DrawerPanel and its host-owned semantic presentation helper.
behaviors.public_action: Run the Theme ownership focal and inspect the mounted DrawerPanel presentation boundary.
behaviors.expected_result: Theme ownership belongs to the host/editor; FluoTheme owns the semantic style roles; DrawerPanel preserves its pre-existing appearance; no global Theme is installed; and external packages do not own Fluo Theme presentation.
invariants: FluoTheme remains editor-side and has no dependency on external package presentation code.
The active editor Theme remains inherited rather than being replaced by a global Fluo Theme.
DrawerPanel style ownership moves to FluoTheme without changing the accepted preview appearance.
behaviors.notes: Automatic marker: [Flujo] Fluo theme ownership test passed. Manual: equivalent appearance confirmed by maintainer desktop review on 2026-10-27.

behaviors.precondition: The editor-side Fluo host is mounted with its backdrop, DrawerMotionShell, and DrawerPanel hierarchy.
behaviors.public_action: Open, close, switch drawer side, exercise the close hierarchy and focus boundary, and run the focused drawer and integration tests.
behaviors.expected_result: DrawerMotionShell is the single Motion wrapper; Backdrop remains its sibling input barrier; DrawerPanel lives inside the shell; the shell owns offset transforms; the ephemeral states are CLOSED, OPENING, OPEN, SWITCHING_SIDE, and CLOSING; current transitions are synchronous; neutral reset is centralized; a reduced-motion policy boundary exists; and no Tween or animation path is present.
invariants: The hierarchy is FluoDrawer with sibling Backdrop and DrawerMotionShell, with DrawerPanel under DrawerMotionShell.
Backdrop is not transformed, and Flow, Flusso, and ScrollContainer content do not receive direct Motion transforms.
Motion state remains editor-only and ephemeral; it does not alter model, selection, focus semantics, or native scrolling.
Desktop manual evidence covers left/right, focus, Escape hierarchy, exterior click, long scroll, equivalent appearance, and absence of visible animation; Android is not approved.
behaviors.notes: Automatic markers: [Flujo] Fluo drawer test passed and [Flujo] Fluo drawer integration test passed on the final focal run 2026-10-28. Manual: Desktop manual review PASS — maintainer approval 🙆‍♀️ — 2026-10-27. No visible Motion is approved for D2; final polish remains D8.

behaviors.precondition: A supported Process or Timer is open through the normal Inspector → Fluo → Flow path and its authoring context exposes integrated and valid external entries.
behaviors.public_action: Inspect the real Add row and activate an integrated or external catalog entry.
behaviors.expected_result: Built-ins and external packages are represented by generic authoring entries; buttons use authoring_id identity, share one authoring context with commands, and Add Call Method remains separate.
invariants: Flow does not enumerate concrete external types or add package-specific editor branches.
The production package root is canonical while tests may inject a fixture root.
The Inspector does not gain a duplicate block list.
behaviors.notes: D3 automated evidence: catalog-driven Process/Timer Add and shared authoring-context focales passed. Manual desktop review recorded separately; no visual FlowId inspection is claimed.

behaviors.precondition: A valid external catalog entry has a metadata- and script-validated descriptor and the selected Process or Timer is editable.
behaviors.public_action: Activate the external Add entry identified by authoring_id.
behaviors.expected_result: The authoring_id resolves through the shared context and external factory into one FlowBlock inserted by the generic editor command, selected by its new FlowId.
invariants: Integrated blocks remain registry-backed and external blocks use the external factory.
A failed or stale authoring entry produces diagnostics without a partial block or undo action.
No external package or concrete block type is hard-coded into Flow/Flusso/runtime.
behaviors.notes: D3 automated evidence covers Process authoring, stale-entry atomic failure, built-in compatibility, external script identity and selection.

behaviors.precondition: An external block was added through the generic authoring command and the owning PVController history is available.
behaviors.public_action: Undo and Redo the external Add, including repeated external instances.
behaviors.expected_result: Undo removes the added instance and Redo restores the same block object and FlowId without recreating it through the factory.
invariants: Redo does not reinvoke authoring-context or factory creation.
Two external Adds remain independent and retain distinct FlowIds and unique display names.
A failed Add records no undo action and leaves the graph unchanged.
behaviors.notes: D3 automated evidence verifies same-instance/same-FlowId redo and one creation call per successful Add.

behaviors.area: External block persistence and generic runtime
behaviors.precondition: A Process or Timer contains an external FlowOutputBlock created through D3 and the scene is saved through the supported PackedScene boundary.
behaviors.public_action: Save/reload the scene and execute the persisted graph through the generic runtime.
behaviors.expected_result: The external script path, exported data, FlowId, order, process identity and enabled state survive reload; runtime executes the persisted FlowBlock without editor authoring infrastructure, fallback, or substitution.
invariants: Runtime does not require editor authoring context, catalog, manifest discovery or external factory.
The external block remains a FlowOutputBlock and is not replaced by a built-in block.
PackedScene persistence preserves deliberate null positions and stable identities.
behaviors.notes: D3 Phase E automated evidence covers editor creation/save/reload plus the runtime helper. FlowId persistence/identity is automated evidence, not a visual manual claim.

behaviors.precondition: A FlowBlock instance exposes reflected properties and may have an optional package-relative block_property_presentation.json sidecar.
behaviors.public_action: Build FlowBlockPropertyCatalog.describe() for the supplied block and optional package metadata.
behaviors.expected_result: The catalog returns deterministic UI-independent descriptors for eligible supported scalar properties, applies only compatible reflected hints and metadata presentation, and reports invalid or unsupported input without mutating the block.
invariants: Reflection remains authoritative for property existence, type, usage, current value, and persistence eligibility.
Private, runtime-only, storage-only, editor-only non-storage, unsupported, and unknown properties do not become generic descriptors.
The descriptor path has no editor API, executable metadata callback, package-specific branch, or container-specific property behavior.
Explicit built-in properties retain host classification and order without establishing Flusso ownership.
Invalid metadata falls back deterministically to reflection and never mutates the FlowBlock.
behaviors.notes: D4-B focal evidence covers supported scalar types, range/enum/multiline hints, deterministic ordering, metadata fallback, eligibility, container independence, package-relative loading, and runtime-boundary audit. D4-C generic Flusso rendering has separate automatic focal evidence and approved manual review.

behaviors.precondition: A selected FlowBlock has D4-B descriptors for eligible supported scalar properties and Flusso is open for the active block session.
behaviors.public_action: Inspect or edit a generic bool, int, float, String, StringName, range, enum, or multiline control, then close or press Revertir.
behaviors.expected_result: Flusso consumes resolved descriptors, renders supported controls deterministically, applies edits live through the existing command boundary, registers only rendered editable properties, and Revertir restores the opening values for the active session.
invariants: Generic rendering does not identify a package, external class, fixture property, or control-flow block.
Existing explicit Block Name, Enabled, Print text, and Method controls are not duplicated.
Unsupported, read-only, invalid, hidden, unrendered, and diagnostic-only properties are not owned.
The same block and descriptor set render equivalently in Process and Timer containers, and separate instances retain independent values and snapshots.
Closing Flusso remains neither Save nor Cancel; Revertir remains the existing session action.
behaviors.notes: D4-C COMPLETE — MANUAL FLUSSO REVIEW PASS in Godot 4.7.2 stable Flathub with human approval 🙆‍♀️. Process PASS; Timer PASS; generic property controls PASS; live editing PASS; Revertir PASS; multiple instances PASS; no duplicate built-ins PASS; container independence PASS. behaviors.area: Fluo Preview 1 Android load and render
behaviors.precondition: The full-project preview for commit cd7e969c38193d718c948262107d1f7a45ca8083 is opened in Godot on Android.
behaviors.public_action: Open a supported container and display Fluo.
behaviors.expected_result: Godot loads the project and renders the Fluo drawer with Flow and Flusso visible without a project-load failure.
invariants: This evidence does not imply complete Android touch, orientation, scrolling, double-tap, or keyboard acceptance.
The tested code checkpoint remains traceable to the frozen preview backup branch.
behaviors.notes: Manual evidence recorded 2026-10-27 from the Android Godot preview screenshot supplied by the maintainer.

behaviors.area: Reusable structured document model, validation, and runtime rendering
behaviors.precondition: A FlowStructuredDocument contains ordered FlowTextSegment and FlowChipSegment resources, including deliberate null positions or invalid authored literal metadata.
behaviors.public_action: Construct, duplicate, validate, render, save, and reload a structured document through the runtime/model contracts.
behaviors.expected_result: Text remains literal and exact; supported literal types render deterministically in segment order; invalid data remains unchanged and produces ordered FlowDiagnostic entries; ResourceSaver preserves concrete classes, IDs, order, values, and Variant.Type.
invariants: Segment identity is generated by FlowId and never depends on array index, text, or label.
Validation is read-only, deterministic, does not normalize values, and preserves deliberate null positions.
Runtime/model code has no dependency on editor APIs, Control, Node state, FPrint, Fluo, or Flusso.
behaviors.notes: Kínder K1/K2 focal evidence. This entry covers reusable Flujo infrastructure and does not claim a visual chip, FPrint Guardería migration, parser, variables, expressions, or editor authoring.

behaviors.area: Reusable Flow chip schema, slot, and value-source core
behaviors.precondition: Runtime model resources define a chip field schema, semantic slot definitions, and typed value sources without an editor or UI dependency.
behaviors.public_action: Construct FIXED, FLEXIBLE, and HYBRID schemas; associate a chip with a semantic slot and literal value source; duplicate the model resources.
behaviors.expected_result: The model preserves explicit text policy, slot meaning, exact literal Variant.Type data, and independent FlowId identities across duplication.
invariants: slot_id names semantic meaning and segment_id names a concrete chip instance.
ValueSource identity is independent from segment identity and is regenerated on independent duplication.
Literal values never use implicit conversion; NIL, unsupported variants, and non-finite floats remain invalid.
The runtime model contains no editor, Control, or persistence-scenario dependency.
behaviors.notes: FPrint Kínder Step 1A focal model evidence. Complete schema validation, complex fixtures, UI, and new scenario persistence remain deferred.

behaviors.area: Reusable chip-field schema instances and validation
behaviors.precondition: A runtime FlowChipFieldSchema declares FIXED, FLEXIBLE, or HYBRID structure, optional text template parts, accepted types/sources, and runtime-safe defaults.
behaviors.public_action: Build an initial FlowStructuredDocument from the schema, validate it, duplicate it, and save/reload the schema/document resources.
behaviors.expected_result: Required fixed slots and minimum variadic content are generated with independent segment/source identities; flexible fields start at their minimum only; text policy is respected; deterministic read-only diagnostics report invalid schema or document data.
invariants: slot_id identifies fixed semantic slots or a declared variadic zone, while segment_id identifies each concrete chip instance.
FIXED, FLEXIBLE, and HYBRID count, type, source-kind, optional-slot, variadic-zone, and reorder rules are declared by the schema rather than private block logic.
Validation never deletes, coerces, normalizes, or replaces invalid document data.
FlowLiteralValueSegment.value_type/value remain the sole persistent legacy literal truth; FlowLiteralValueSource remains an adapter boundary.
ResourceSaver and deep duplication preserve order, text, slot associations, literal data, and independent IDs without editor/runtime coupling.
behaviors.notes: FPrint Kínder Step 1B implementation evidence. No inline editor, block execution, For/If/Process type, FPrint migration, or visual chip surface is included.

behaviors.precondition: The approved mercury.fprint package is available under res://flow_packages and a schema 3 FlowProcess can be authored through the public catalog path.
behaviors.public_action: Discover, add, configure, persist, duplicate, reload, and execute FPrint through the public FlowBlock/FlowOutputBlock contract.
behaviors.expected_result: FPrint is discovered as mercury.fprint:fprint, added as an independent FlowOutputBlock, renders Prefix/Message/Suffix generically, composes prefix + message + suffix, persists and reloads its values, and executes through Process.
invariants: The manifest is v1 with exactly one descriptor and the presentation sidecar is data-only.
FPrint receives valid independent FlowIds and duplication preserves values without sharing instances.
Runtime uses get_output_message() and has no Builder, editor, package-specific, or container-specific dependency.
Process is the only host integration claimed by this delivery; Timer, State Machine, and future containers are not FPrint tests.
behaviors.notes: Fresh 2026-10-29 model, editor, and Process runtime runs pass after the K5 focal expectation correction. The separate manual Guardería review remains approved; no Timer/State Machine/future-container claim is made.

behaviors.precondition: The approved mercury.fprint package is opened through the normal Inspector → Fluo → Flow → Flusso path in Godot 4.7.2 stable Flathub.
behaviors.public_action: Add FPrint to Process, edit Prefix/Message/Suffix, use live editing and Revertir, and execute the Process output.
behaviors.expected_result: FPrint is visible and editable through the generic host path, Revertir works, independent instances remain independent, and Process emits the configured literal prefix + message + suffix output.
invariants: The manual pass covers the bounded Guardería slice only; Timer, State Machine and future containers are not claimed.
